response.rationale: All 10 cited items are positive and none are negative, and most are T3 SMPY longitudinal studies showing that early aptitude, including differences within the top 1%, tilt and spatial ability, predicts doctorates, patents, publications and eminence, while Hambrick 2016 and Vaci 2019 show aptitude working alongside practice and other factors. Two caveats lower confidence: the evidence mostly comes from one cohort (SMPY), and the last two items (lubinski-2006-smpy-after-35-years and lubinski-2001-top-1-in-10-000) have identical summary text, so they may not be independent.
